messages:
maria: Heads up — EU pool just dropped ~30 units after depot RMA returns. We need 40 H100s staged for the May10 batch. @anton_vendor can you confirm allocation and whether you can split shipments to FRA to avoid the AMS customs backlog?
shaun: We have two clusters (FRA/AMS); FRA is underprovisioned. If we can get 20 to FRA and 20 to DUB for staging that would cover it.
lucy: Quick ask — what's the expected uplift if we do air expedite vs standard? Need a rough cost delta to run by finance.
anton_vendor: Current allocation shows 58 H100s available across EU pools. Standard lead time: 6-8 wks by sea. Air expedite: 2-3 wks. For 40 units by air we can do ~17 business days, but freight uplift is +18% and depot handling is €85/unit.
maria: 18% is steep. Is depot handling negotiable for warranty/RMA replacements? If vendor can absorb depot fee we can accept the freight uplift.
anton_vendor: Depot fee is policy, but for this one-off we can waive 50% if you agree to consolidated AWB and handle customs brokerage. Also propose routing RMA returns to our Berlin refurb depot to cut customs paperwork on your side.
ops-bot: Alert: FRA cluster currently has 12 pending DOA swaps. Reclaim window if depot accepts immediate scan: 5-7 business days.
shaun: If we route returns to BER refurb and consolidate AWB that should reduce turn time. Can you cover 50% depot fee in writing? ops needs that to free staging slots.
anton_vendor: Confirming provisional: ETA 17 business days, freight +18%, depot fee €85/unit -> vendor pays €42.50/unit. Need PO amendment with AWB consolidation flag and BER RMA return address. I'll attach AWB draft once PO is updated.
lucy: I'll start the PO amendment. @maria please confirm accounting code for uplift so finance can pre-authorize.
maria: Use account INF-GPU-EXP. Add instruction: accelerate kitting at DUB to avoid an extra 48hr hold.
anton_vendor: Draft AWB posted to thread for visibility:
```
AWB: 123-45678901
Consolidated route: Air -> FRA (20) + DUB (20) split at destination hub
RMA return: RMA-BER-12 (Berlin refurb depot)
Special flag: CONSOLIDATE_AWB=true
```
lucy: Got it, prepping PO amendment with the AWB flag now.
shaun: Ack on routing change. We'll patch the staging playbook and inform oncall. :thumbsup: 
maria: Thanks — please confirm once AWB is final and PO signed. We need shipping notice 48h before flight.
anton_vendor: Will send final AWB and updated commercial invoice EOD. If anything changes I'll update here.
